Unstarred Questions

Monsoon Session 2021
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 458 Subject: Status of MGNREGA Implementation Asked by: SHRI ADHIR RANJAN CHOWDHURY SHRI GIRIRAJ SINGH MINISTER OF RURAL DEVELOPMENT : WRITTEN ANSWER The details of MGNREGA implementation as on date are as follows. A total of 7.5 crore households have been provided employment. The programme has generated 2.5 billion person-days of employment in the current year.
